_readme: Match results for BRYME Sports. Keyed by league slug, then by match slug (home id + '-vs-' + away id, matching the fixture). A result MUST carry a source with a url - the build refuses to publish an unsourced result. Add results with: node scripts/add-result.js. Validate with: node scripts/validate-results.js

_schema.status: FT | AET | FT (pens) - optional, defaults to FT
_schema.penalties: optional string, e.g. '4-3' - only for FT (pens)
_schema.source: REQUIRED object {name, url} - where the result was confirmed
_schema.verifiedOn: YYYY-MM-DD, optional - when you checked it
